name: Fort Main Gate
player_description: The porta praetoria -- two towers, a wooden gate reinforced with iron, a narrow killing ground between inner and outer doors. The watch changes every four hours. Guards check entry passes during the day; after dark, the password is required.
gm_notes: DC 13 Perception: the gate is understaffed tonight -- one guard post is empty. DC 15 Insight: the remaining guard looks nervous, not tired. Someone is expected. Relevant in Session 1 before Lucius arrives.
